source_matching: sha256(UTF-8 basename including .csv), then exact raw CSV byte SHA256

config.history_semantics: 360 grid observations ending at origin; approximately 60 minutes
config.label_semantics: each future grid tick uses last actual record in (t-10s,t]; no interpolation or held labels
config.normalization: global shared per-channel median/IQR from fresh accepted operating training observations only
config.range_rules: NO/flows nonnegative; O2 <=21 per prior protocol; Celsius >=-273.15; thermal feedback in raw 0..100 percent; preserve all raw values and flags

historical_exposure.scr: same source period and test already examined in existing NOx baseline work
historical_exposure.main_steam: source period used by earlier thermal experiments; these new splits are not an unseen holdout claim
historical_exposure.reheat_steam: historical source existed in project; no claim of previously unseen measurements

excluded_source_channels.a_gas_flow_and_b_gas_flow: full source audit found both constant zero; no physical flow inferred
excluded_source_channels.fgd_and_hour: outside current SCR inlet/outlet task; avoids mixing monitoring locations/hourly-release semantics
excluded_source_channels.a_no2_sensor_and_b_no2_sensor: optional second NO instruments, not NO2 species

scr.routing: reagent groups retain original identities; group-to-SCR-side allocation unconfirmed
